name: @oresoftware/ores-gh-bots
description: Event-driven, dual-provider GitHub pull-request review gates for the ORES fleet, plus the nightly cross-org PR reconciler (dependency-graph-driven PR refresh, readiness-gated auto-merge) and fleet git hygiene.

scripts.test: npm run test:review && npm run test:nightly
scripts.lint:ores: if [ -f .ores-lint/lint.sh ]; then sh .ores-lint/lint.sh; else echo 'ores-lint not installed'; fi
scripts.verify: npm run verify:repository && npm run verify:github-apps

comments.typecheck: The nightly reconciler and its tests use only Node built-ins, so there is no install step; `npm run typecheck` pulls typescript/@types/node through npx on demand so the workspace lockfile stays dependency-free (`npm ci --ignore-scripts` in CI).

oresLint.note: Declared, not installed. ores-lint resolves these from a global install - see .ores-lint/README.md
